entries.wording: Les données du colis ont été intégrées dans nos systèmes.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été programmé.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le ramassage est en attente, le livreur se présentera sous peu.
entries.note: Seen live as the first event of a parcel from abroad; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: Le colis a été collecté par le livreur.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis est arrivé au hub d'origine.
entries.note: Seen live as the event type; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: Le colis a quitté notre hub.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis est arrivé au hub.
entries.note: Seen live as the event type; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: Le colis a été assigné à un partenaire tiers.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis a été confié à un partenaire tiers.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: arrivé dans le pays.
entries.note: Seen live as the event type; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: dédouanement en cours
entries.note: Seen live as the event type; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: dédouanement terminé
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Cleared by customs, so back in transit.

entries.wording: Le colis est retenu au hub.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Delivery Scheduled
entries.note: The reply's own label: the parcel was put on a delivery run at the destination hub. The page has no message for it.

entries.wording: Out For Delivery
entries.note: The reply's own label: the courier took the parcel out on the run. The page has no message for it.

entries.wording: Le colis est en cours de livraison.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis a été livré.
entries.note: Seen live as the event type; the wording is the tracking page's message for it.

entries.wording: Call Log
entries.note: The courier's call to the recipient before a delivery: nothing moves, and the page and the adapter leave it out.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué : le client n'a pas répondu ou était injoignable.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué : le lieu de livraison est incorrect ou introuvable.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué : le client a refusé le colis.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué : le client est indisponible.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué : le client n'a pas le montant COD requis.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. COD means cash on delivery.

entries.wording: La livraison a échoué.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: La livraison a été annulée : le colis est endommagé et ne peut pas être livré.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis a été annulé.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.

entries.wording: Le colis va être renvoyé à l'expéditeur.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Return to sender has started.

entries.wording: Le colis a été retourné à l'adresse de l'expéditeur.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. The return reached the sender.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été annulé à la demande du client.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup cancelled at the customer's request: nothing was collected.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été annulé : l'étiquette est manquante ou illisible.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup cancelled: missing or unreadable label.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été annulé : le colis est endommagé et ne peut pas être pris en charge.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup cancelled: damaged parcel.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été annulé : le colis dépasse les limites de dimensions et/ou de poids.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup cancelled: over the size or weight limits.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été annulé : l'emaballage du colis ne permet pas la prise en charge.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup cancelled: packaging unfit for collection.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été reprogrammé : une nouvelle date a été définie.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup rescheduled: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été reprogrammé : ue nouvelle adresse a été définie.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup rescheduled to a new address: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été reprogrammé : le colis n'est pas prêt.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup rescheduled: the parcel was not ready.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a été reprogrammé par manque de temps du livreur.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Pickup rescheduled: the courier ran out of time.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a échoué : le client n'a pas répondu ou était injoignable.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Failed pickup: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a échoué : le lieu de livraison est incorrect ou introuvable.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Failed pickup: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a échoué : le client a refusé la prise en charge.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Failed pickup: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a échoué : le client est indisponible.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Failed pickup: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le ramassage a échoué.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Failed pickup: the parcel still waits for the courier.

entries.wording: Le colis est en attente au hub.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Waiting at the hub for its next run.

entries.wording: Le colis a été reprogrammé.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. The delivery was moved to another run.

entries.wording: La livraison a été annulée à la demande du client.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Delivery cancelled at the customer's request.

entries.wording: La livraison a été reprogrammée : une nouvelle date a été définie.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Delivery moved to a new date.

entries.wording: La livraison a été reprogrammée : ue nouvelle adresse a été définie.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Delivery moved to a new address.

entries.wording: La livraison a été reprogrammée par manque de temps du livreur.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Delivery moved: the courier ran out of time, with no attempt.

entries.wording: La livraison a été reprogrammée.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code. Delivery moved to another run.

entries.wording: arrivé à l'aéroport.
entries.note: From the status table in the tracking page's script, keyed by the event code.
